questions.question_text: A 2 kg body moving at 6 m/s is brought to rest. How much work is done by the stopping force?
questions.explanation: The work equals the change in kinetic energy: 0 - (1/2 x 2 x 6^2) = -36 J.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: A body floats at rest in a liquid. Which relation holds between buoyant force and the body's weight?
questions.option_d: Weight is necessarily twice the buoyant force
questions.explanation: For a floating body in equilibrium, upward buoyancy balances downward weight.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: Why does a steel ship float although steel is denser than water?
questions.option_a: Gravity does not act on ships
questions.option_b: Water exerts no force on steel
questions.option_c: Its hollow shape makes the ship's average density less than water and it displaces enough water
questions.option_d: Steel becomes less dense whenever painted
questions.explanation: The ship encloses air and displaces water; the buoyant force can balance its total weight.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: A hydraulic lift has a small piston area of 0.01 m^2 and a large piston area of 0.5 m^2. If 100 N is applied to the small piston, the ideal output force is
questions.explanation: Pascal's principle gives equal pressure: F2 = 100 x (0.5/0.01) = 5000 N.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: During melting of a pure solid at its melting point, supplied heat mainly
questions.option_a: changes the state by overcoming intermolecular attraction while temperature stays constant
questions.explanation: Latent heat is absorbed during the phase change without a temperature rise for a pure substance at fixed pressure.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: Why can evaporation cool a liquid?
questions.option_b: Higher-energy molecules escape, lowering the average kinetic energy of those left
questions.explanation: Preferential escape of energetic molecules reduces the average kinetic energy and temperature of the remaining liquid.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: Which mode of heat transfer can carry energy from the Sun through the vacuum of space?
questions.explanation: Electromagnetic radiation does not require a material medium.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: A metal spoon's handle becomes warm when its other end is placed in hot tea. The dominant transfer through the spoon is
questions.explanation: Conduction transfers thermal energy through a material without bulk motion of the material.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: Warm air rises in a room primarily because heating makes it
questions.option_a: less dense than the surrounding cooler air
questions.option_b: more dense than the surrounding cooler air
questions.explanation: Thermal expansion lowers the density of warm air, so buoyancy drives convection.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.explanation: Force and displacement have magnitude and direction; the other listed quantities are scalars.

questions.question_text: A 20 N force acts at right angles to a displacement of 3 m. What work does this force do?
questions.explanation: W = Fs cos(theta); cos 90 degrees is zero.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: A 100 W device operates for 30 s. How much energy does it transfer?
questions.explanation: Energy = power x time = 100 x 30 = 3000 J.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php
